1.mascotDialogue: Same idea, one more pointer join the queue. But now — every insert update FOUR pointer, not two. Miss one, list look shiok going forward, disaster going back.

2.mascotDialogue: Lines 9 to 13. Four-pointer dance. New node next, new node prev, old neighbour prev, target next. Miss line 11, backward walk break quietly while forward walk continue like nothing happen.

3.mascotDialogue: Arrows come in pairs now. Every connection between two nodes actually two pointers, agreeing with each other.

4.mascotDialogue: This why doubly linked list give more trouble than singly one — forward direction can look perfect, backward direction already rot behind your back.
